text: If you change the type definition data type of a custom control from numeric to string. How LabVIEW converts the old default value to the new data type? (one or more answers may apply)
options: LabVIEW cannot preserve the instance default value if the data type changes to an incompatible type.
LabVIEW sets the instance default to a value such as zero or an empty string.
LabVIEW will replace all the numeric values in the form of ASCII codes and display the respective ASCII string.
LabVIEW will repeat the same numeric values in the string controls/indicators
